title: Dept Collectors
description: You are broke, in fact; you are in SERIUS dept. To pay of that dept, the people you owe money has sent you to a strange world. You mission is to kill of other dept collectors in your way and pay of your dept.
body:
# **Dept Collectors**

### **Heavy** lore incoming:

You are poor, really poor. In fact, you have negative money. You are in dept.
Serius dept might I say. The people you owe are criminals (as usual smh), and these fellers has sent you into a weird world, an anter dimention even. The **Mirror-Verse**. 
  Your job in this here "mirror-verse" is to collect money. They don't care how, but they do care when. In this time, you are late on this days payment. They are coming for you.
But these guys are cowards, they don't want to go in there themselves, no. They have sent other dept collectors after you, to by any means nessesary, get you **killed**, they don't care about your money. You have wronged them and they feel betrayed. 
 You will need to fend them off to avoid death. You are endangered. You are a dead man (or woman*) walking. 

*or whatever you are.

## Content: 

This mod offers a wide varity of things to do, but try to focus on getting a collectors bag. In this collectors bag all your money is stored (not really it is in a variable and stays the same between bags but pretend). Fill this bag up with money, you will know when the people you owe feel like they got their money back.

### _? Note some Monsters might have a bag, meaning they are dept collectors as well, kill them and see!_

And oh yeah, you'll need Geckolib and JEI to use the mod!

Try it out / Q
